thread:
Maya: quick sync on roles grid keyboard + audit deep-linking. screenshot in figma: https://figma.com/s/proto-roles-nav
Ashley: saw it. a11y problem: when invite modal closes focus isn't restored to the role row. SR users lose place.
Ron: fix is to save document.activeElement before open and restore on close. watch for VoiceOver virtual cursor.
Ashley: ARIA: set role=dialog and aria-modal=true. announce the role name in the dialog header. change toast to 'Invitation sent — returning to roles'.
Sam: request: support deep-links from role invite -> exact audit event. propose audit URL params like ?event_id=12345.
Ron: backend uses cursor pagination. I'll add a small endpoint GET /audit/locate?event_id=... to return cursor.
Devon: copy: change 'Enforce SSO for invites' -> 'Require SSO to join org'. tooltip: 'Users must sign in via your SSO to accept invites.'
Ashley: keyboard nav: use roving tabindex; arrow keys move, Enter opens invite, Space toggles selection. add hidden region that explains shortcuts.
Ron: might implement grid with role=grid rather than native table for predictable focus management.
Sam: landing on audit deep-link should autofocus the event row and use aria-live='polite' to announce selection.
Maya: action items: Ron prototype grid+roving (EOW), Ron add audit locate POC, Ashley update aria/copy in figma, Sam add SR test cases, Devon draft two copy variants. I'll schedule quick usability Tue.
AuditBot: created ticket AUD-492 for audit locate endpoint. :white_check_mark:
